title: 第一卷 第15章 收徒考核技惊四座第一卷 第16章 苏晴雨加入叶家
lines: 叶蓉凤顿时气得够呛，胸脯剧烈起伏，还想要说什么。
“姨娘，算了吧，没必要与这等毫无见识的妇人争吵。”
叶无尘拉住叶蓉凤的手，连连摇头。
叶蓉凤无奈叹息，捏了捏叶无尘的小脸蛋道：“尘儿，哎，你就是自小太懂事了，所以才处处忍让吃亏。”
“姨娘，你相信我，这周氏得意不了多久了。”
“喔，尘儿你有对付她的办法吗？”
叶无尘笑道：“周氏嚣张跋扈，无非是姜牧野带给她的底气，她越是满怀期待，到时候姜牧野落选了，就越会失魂落魄！”
叶蓉凤惊讶道：“姜牧野可有七品灵根，尘儿你觉得他会落选吗？”
“姨娘，你就等着看好戏吧！”叶无尘神秘一笑，自信满满。
叶蓉凤点了点头，虽然她这个小外甥只有三岁大，但古灵精怪，鬼点子多，说不定真能让周丽婷狠狠吃一次瘪。
“快看，苏姑娘出来了！”
“哇，好美啊！”
“还真是翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙，不愧为青州四大美人之一！”
现场忽然一片沸腾，无数男性眼中都流露出痴迷之色，由衷赞叹。
只见聚仙楼二楼所在，一位身着水蓝色裙纱的女子现身，身躯修长，体态婀娜，缓缓走下阶梯。
她看起来双十年华，黑发如瀑，生有一张绝美的瓜子脸蛋，明眸皓齿，柳眉弯弯，剪水双瞳，如一泓清泉。
遗世独立，宛若谪仙！
一股清冷绝尘之感，让人心生自卑，不敢接近。
苏晴雨，实在太美了，浑身肌体如羊脂白玉，吹弹欲破，光可鉴人。薄如蝉翼的蓝色裙纱下，一双滚圆修长的美腿若隐若现，透着朦朦胧胧的性感之美。
“诸位道友，收徒仪式已经开始，还请十二岁以上的无关人员后退十步，期间保持安静，不得吵闹。”
她的声音如大珠小珠落玉盘，清脆动人，眸波流转，顾盼生辉。
一时间，所有无关人员都遵循着规矩，往后倒退十步，留出一大块空地来。
苏晴雨点点头，随后看向在场的十二岁以下的孩子道：“你们向前十步，考核现在开始了！”
“表弟，表弟，这苏姑娘真漂亮啊，就像天上的神仙姐姐一样！”
叶英雄看呆了，眼睛瞪直。
叶无尘拿手肘捅了他一下道：“别发呆了，考核已经开始！”
在现场一众小孩中，最属姜牧野自信，鹤立鸡群一般，最先踏出十步，来到苏晴雨面前，拱手作揖道：“小辈姜牧野见过苏老师！”
苏晴雨看了姜牧野一点，美眸中闪过异彩道：“你就是镇北侯府中，七品灵根的麒麟孙？”
“正是。”姜牧野点点头。
“小辈周月儿见过苏老师！”这时，一名唇红齿白，长着可爱圆脸的女孩也走上前来。
“周月儿？周家家主的嫡孙女，六品灵根？”
content_en:
Ye Rongfeng was suddenly so angry that her chest heaved violently and she wanted to say something else.
"Auntie, forget it, there is no need to argue with such an ignorant woman."
Ye Wuchen took Ye Rongfeng's hand and shook his head repeatedly.
Ye Rongfeng sighed helplessly, pinched Ye Wuchen's little face and said: "Chen'er, hey, you have been too sensible since you were a child, so you tolerate suffering in every situation."
"Auntie, believe me, Zhou will not be proud for long."
"Oh, Chen'er, do you have any way to deal with her?"
Ye Wuchen smiled and said: "Zhou's arrogance and domineeringness are nothing more than the confidence Jiang Muye gave her. The more she looks forward to it, the more devastated she will be when Jiang Muye loses the election!"
Ye Rongfeng said in surprise: "Jiang Muye has a seventh-grade spiritual root. Chen'er, do you think he will lose the election?"
"Auntie, just wait and see the good show!" Ye Wuchen smiled mysteriously, full of confidence.
Ye Rongfeng nodded. Although her little nephew was only three years old, he was quirky and full of clever ideas. He might really make Zhou Liting suffer.
"Look, Miss Su is out!"
"Wow, so beautiful!"
"She is as graceful as a startling giant, as graceful as a swimming dragon. She deserves to be one of the four beauties of Qingzhou!"
The scene suddenly burst into excitement, with countless men showing fascination in their eyes and admiring from the bottom of their hearts.
On the second floor of Juxian Building, a woman wearing aqua blue skirt appeared, with a slender body and graceful figure, slowly walking down the stairs.
She looks to be twenty years old, with black hair like a waterfall, a beautiful face with oval seeds, bright eyes, white teeth, curved eyebrows, and clear pupils like a clear spring.
Being independent from the world is like banishing an immortal!
A feeling of coldness and purity makes people feel inferior and dare not approach.
Su Qingyu is so beautiful, her whole body is like mutton-fat white jade, which is about to be broken by a blow, and the light can tell people. Under the thin blue skirt, a pair of round and slender legs are looming, revealing a hazy sexy beauty.
"Fellow Taoists, the apprenticeship ceremony has begun. All non-residents over the age of twelve are asked to step back ten steps. During this period, please keep quiet and do not make any noise."
Her voice is like big beads and small beads falling on a jade plate, clear and moving, and her eyes are flowing and shining with hope.
For a time, all unrelated people followed the rules and stepped back ten steps, leaving a large space.
Su Qingyu nodded, then looked at the children under the age of twelve present and said: "You take ten steps forward, the assessment begins now!"
"Cousin, cousin, this girl Su is so beautiful, like a fairy sister in the sky!"
Ye Yingxiong was stunned, his eyes widened.
Ye Wuchen poked him with his elbow and said, "Don't be in a daze, the assessment has begun!"
Among the children at the scene, Jiang Muye was the most confident, standing out from the crowd. He was the first to take ten steps and came to Su Qingyu. He bowed his hands and said, "Junior Jiang Muye has met Teacher Su!"
Su Qingyu looked at Jiang Muye for a moment, then a flash of light flashed in her beautiful eyes and said, "Are you the Qilin grandson of the seventh-grade spiritual root in the Zhenbei Hou Mansion?"
"Exactly." Jiang Muye nodded.
"Junior Zhou Yue'er has met Teacher Su!" At this time, a girl with red lips and white teeth and a cute round face also came forward.
"Zhou Yue'er? The granddaughter of the head of the Zhou family, with a sixth-grade spiritual root?"
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 15: Apprentice Recruitment and Assessment Skills Shocked Four Members Volume 1, Chapter 16: Su Qingyu Joins the Ye Family
